verdict.rationale: Clerk documents custom Roles and 'fine-grained Permissions' scoped to Organizations, plus permission and scope checks on eve tool calls and OAuth scoped access. These are still role- and permission-based (org-level RBAC) or adjacent scope controls. Nothing in the evidence shows resource-level, relationship-based (ReBAC) or policy-based (ABAC) authorization, and a community report notes roles are tied to organizations rather than offering richer models.
